title: Contact without phone
prompt:
Name: Asha Rao; email: asha@example.test; phone unspecified. Extract name,email,phone. Return only valid JSON with exactly these fields: name, email, phone. Numeric values must be JSON numbers; boolean values must be JSON booleans; absent values null. No extra fields.

Write that JSON, and nothing else, to answer.json in the current directory.
acceptance: answer.json equals the gold answer under Abdul's equality rule
